y-m-07-06.title: Amakhadi amanani ama-3: isiphumo siba sikhulu phi?
y-m-07-06.topic: Ukufumana iimeko ezinesiphumo esikhulu xa kwenziwa ukubonakaliswa (inani elinamanani amabini)×(inani elinamanani e-1) ngamakhadi amanani
y-m-07-06.goal: Vavanya ingcamango yokuba "ukuba wenza elona nani likhulu elinamanani amabini, isiphumo naso siba sikhulu kakhulu" ngokwenza ukubonakaliswa wena, ufumane ukubonakaliswa okuninzi okunesiphumo esikhulu, uze ubhale isizathu.
y-m-07-06.material: Kukho ikhadi elinye lalo naliphi na lamakhadi amanani 3, 5 no-7. Sebenzisa ikhadi ngalinye kanye ukwenza ukubonakaliswa (inani elinamanani amabini)×(inani elinamanani e-1). Umzekelo, beka u-3 no-5 ecaleni kwenye wenze u-35 uze uphindaphinde ngo-7, unike u-35×7 (amashumi amathathu anesihlanu amaxesha asixhenxe). Musa ukujika amakhadi. UHarin wathi, "Ukuba ndenza elona nani likhulu elinamanani amabini, u-75, ndiphindaphinde ngo-3, isiphumo siya kuba sikhulu kakhulu!"
y-m-07-06.thinking.2: Ukucacisa isizathu sokuba isiphumo sibe sikhulu
y-m-07-06.prereq.1: Indlela yokwenza inani elinamanani amabini ngamakhadi amanani (indawo yamashumi, indawo ye-unithi)
y-m-07-06.s.s1.prompt: Khetha isigwebo onokusenza ngoku ngoko kwathethwa nguHarin.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.hint.0: Yenza enye indlela ngaphandle kwe-75×3, uyibale wena, uze uthelekise iziphumo.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.hint.1: Qala ubale ukuba zingaphi izibonakaliso ezinokwenziwa ngamakhadi ama-3 ngokupheleleyo.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.o.a: Ilunge. Xa inani elinamanani amabini likhulu kakhulu, isiphumo naso sikhulu kakhulu.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.r.a: Inani e-1 ophindaphinda ngalo liyatshintsha nalo ngokweekhadi. Akufuneki ujonge inani elinamanani amabini kuphela.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.o.b: Asikazi okwangoku. Kufuneka sithelekise nesiphumo seminye imigqibelelo yamakhadi.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.r.b: Oku kubonile ukuba kufuneka uvavanye ukuba isibakala silunge na ngokuthelekisa nezinye izibonakaliso. Ngugwebo olulungileyo lokuzama ukuqokelela ubungqina.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.o.c: Ayibonakali ilunge. Umphindaphindi 3 mncinci, ngoko ungaba lilahleko.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.r.c: Oku kuye kwabonisa ukuba umphindaphindi uyancipha. Kodwa kuba kukuqikelela, kufuneka uhlole ngokuthelekisa nezinye izibonakaliso.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.o.d: Isiphumo siyafana nokuba uzibeka njani, ngoko akukho mfuneko yokuthelekisa.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.r.d: Ngaphambi kokumisela ukuba iziphumo ziyafana, bala ezimbalwa izibonakaliso wena. Zinokwahluka kakhulu.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.explain: 75×3=225. Ukuba ubala ezinye izibonakaliso, kukho iziphumo ezikhulu, njenge-35×7=245. Isibakala sikaHarin asilunganga, kodwa ukuzama ezimbalwa izibonakaliso kuqala yindlela entle yokuhlola.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.acc.0: Oku kuqikelelo olunengqiqo. Kodwa kuba kukuqikelela, kufuneka ufumane iziphumo wena ukuze uhlole.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.prompt: Yenza izibonakaliso ezi-2 ezahlukeneyo ezinesiphumo esikhulu kuno-240. Ikhadi lamashumi yi-t, ikhadi le-unithi yi-u, yaye ikhadi lokuphindaphinda yi-m. Kufuneka usebenzise amakhadi 3, 5 no-7 kanye nganye.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.hint.0: Beka ikhadi elinye kwindawo yamashumi, kwindawo ye-unithi nakwindawo yomphindaphindi uze ubale isiphumo.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.hint.1: Uthatha isiphumo se-75×3 njengomgangatho, thelekisa ukuba isiphumo siyatshintsha njani xa utshintsha indawo obeka kuyo u-7.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Zonke iindawo ezintathu zingenye ye-3, 5 okanye 7.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Akufuneki usebenzise ikhadi elinye kabini. Kufuneka usebenzise 3, 5 no-7 kanye nganye.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Isiphumo asikhulu kuno-240. Zama ukutshintsha iindawo zamakhadi.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.explain: Kukho izibonakaliso ezi-6 ngokupheleleyo ezinokwenziwa ngamakhadi ama-3. Kwezo, izibonakaliso ezi-3 zikhulu kuno-240, yaye i-35×7=245 ngumzekelo omnye. I-75×3 kaHarin yi-225, ngoko ayifikeleli ku-240.
y-m-07-06.s.s3.prompt: Kuzo izibonakaliso ezi-6 ezinokwenziwa ngamakhadi 3, 5 no-7, siyiphi esinesiphumo esikhulu kakhulu? Yaye bhala isizathu sokuba indlela kaHarin (75×3) ingasinikanga isiphumo esikhulu kakhulu.
y-m-07-06.s.s3.hint.0: Bala iziphumo zazo zonke izibonakaliso ezi-6, ubhale etafileni, uze uxande elona likhulu.
y-m-07-06.s.s3.hint.1: Thelekisa ukuba liliphi ikhadi elingumphindaphindi kwisibonakaliso esinesiphumo esikhulu kakhulu nakwisibonakaliso sikaHarin.

y-m-07-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba unqumle isiphumo esikhulu kakhulu emva kokubala zonke ezi-6?
y-m-07-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uthelekise indawo ebekwe kuyo u-7 kwisibonakaliso sikaHarin nakwisibonakaliso esinesiphumo esikhulu kakhulu?

y-m-07-05.title: 1/2 ne-1/4 yeribhoni: ngubani osebenzise ngaphezulu?
y-m-07-05.topic: Amaqhezu anokuthelekiswa ngobukhulu kuphela xa isiqingatha sinye (amaqhezu eziqingatha ezahlukeneyo)
y-m-07-05.goal: Qonda ukuba amaqhezu eziqingatha ezahlukeneyo awanakuthelekiswa ngobukhulu bamaqhezu odwa, hlela ukuba luluphi ulwazi olenza ukuthelekisa kwenzeke, uze ufumane ngamanani iimeko apho ubude obusetyenziswe ngabantu aba babini bufana.
y-m-07-05.material: UJian wasebenzisa 1/2 yeribhoni ebomvu, yaye uDoyun wasebenzisa 1/4 yeribhoni eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka. Asazi ukuba ezo ribhoni zimbini zazinobude obufanayo ekuqaleni. Iribhoni nganye yayiyingcambu enye engeqanywanga, yaye 1/2 ne-1/4 zithetha iribhoni yonke yomntu ngamnye ehlulwe yangamacandelo alinganayo. 1/2 ifundwa ngokuthi "isiqingatha" yaye 1/4 ifundwa ngokuthi "ikota."

y-m-07-02.title: Iingxowa ezi-6 ezinemabula ezili-47 nganye, iindlela ezintathu zokubala
y-m-07-02.topic: Iindlela ezininzi zokubala (inani leedijithi ezimbini)×(inani ledijithi enye) ngokwahlula inani
y-m-07-02.goal: Fumana uze ulungise umgca ongalunganga kwiindlela zokubala ngokwahlula inani, uze ukhangele ngomzekelo wakho ukuba ukwahlula ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo kunika isixa esifanayo, emva koko uchaze isizathu.
y-m-07-02.material: Kukho iimabula ezili-47 kwingxowa nganye, kwaye zingxowa ezi-6 zizonke. Abahlobo abathathu bafumana isixa seemabula ngokutshintsha i-47 ibe linani elilula ukubala ngalo. Indlela yokufunda: 47×6 ifundwa ngokuthi 'amashumi maneananci kane kuphindwe kasithandathu'.

Ukwahlula ube yi-40 ne-7 nokwahlula ube yi-7 ne-40 kubalwa njengokwahlula okunye.

y-m-07-01.title: Ndingasithenga isidlo esincinci nesiselo nge-1000 won?
y-m-07-01.topic: Xa uqikelela amanani amathathu amadijithi, ungafunda ntoni xa uqikelelo lulingana nomgangatho?
y-m-07-01.goal: Qonda ukuba xa uqikelelo lufana ngqo nomgangatho (1000 won), kunzima ukufikelela esigqibeni ngokuqikelela kuphela. Lungisa isigwebo sakho nendlela oqinisekile ngayo ixesha ngalinye xa kufika ulwazi olutsha, uze wenze umzekelo apho, nokuba uqikelelo luyafana, amaxabiso okwenyani anokuba macala omabini omgangatho.
y-m-07-01.material: UHajun ufuna ukuthenga isidlo esincinci esinye nesiselo esinye evenkileni. Ingxowa yakhe inamaphepha e-1000 won e-1 kuphela. Onke amaxabiso ngamanani emvelo ngee-won. Xa uqikelela kwikhulu eliphantsi, jikelezela ngaphezulu ukuba idijithi yeshumi ingu-5 okanye ngaphezulu kwaye jikelezela ngaphantsi ukuba ingu-4 okanye ngaphantsi. Umzekelo, 460 liqikelelwa njenge-500 kwaye 440 njenge-400.

y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Xa asondela wajonga, isidlo esincinci sasingama-487 won kwaye isiselo sasingama-518 won.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ngoku, ucinga ukuba isixa samaxabiso amabini sithelekiswa njani ne-1000 won?
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.after: 487 incinci nge-13 kune-500 kwaye 518 inkulu nge-18 kune-500, ngoko isixa sikhulu nge-5 kune-1000. Ukudibanisa ngqo, 487+518=1005. Isigwebo sokuqala sokuba "kunzima ukugqiba" sasisachanekile, kwaye ngoku kukho isizathu.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ukugqitha i-18 kukhulu kunokushiyeka kwe-13, ngoko isixa sikhulu kune-1000 won.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Oku kufumene ukuba 518 inkulu nge-18 kune-500 kwaye 487 incinci nge-13 kune-500, kwaye kwathelekisa isixa esigqithileyo nesixa esishiyekileyo. Yindlela entle yokujonga amaxabiso aqikelelweyo kwakhona ngamanani.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 487 incinci kune-500, ngoko isixa sincinci kune-1000 won nalo.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Oku kushiye ukuba 518 inkulu kune-500. Kufuneka ujonge ukuba ixabiso ngalinye lahluka kangakanani kwi-500 kunye.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Zombini zimalunga ne-500, ngoko isixa singama-1000 won ngqo njengoko sinjalo.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: "Malunga" akuthethi okufanayo. Fumana umahluko phakathi kwenani lethegi yexabiso nganye kunye ne-500.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ukuqikelela kodwa akukuxeleli, ngoko ndiza kudibanisa 487+518 ngokuchanekileyo ukugqiba.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Esi sigwebo sicinga ukuba uqikelelo alwanelanga kwaye lizama ukuhlola ngokubala ngokuchanekileyo. Ngumkhwa omhle ukusebenzisa ukuqikelela nokubala kunye.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.info: UHajun ufumene iingqekembe ezi-2 ezongezelelweyo zama-10 won ngaphakathi kwingxowa yakhe. Ngoku imali anayo ingama-1020 won.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Angathini xa enza isigwebo ngokubandakanya inyaniso entsha?
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.after: 1005 won ingaphantsi kwe-1020 won, ngoko unokuzithenga yaye kusala i-15 won. Nangona amaxabiso efana, xa imali onayo itshintsha, isigqibo siyatshintsha. Ukugqiba ngoqikelelo lwe-1000 kuphela kwakulungile kule mpelaveki, kodwa isizathu sakho sasibuthathaka.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Isixa sesi-1005 won, esingaphezulu kwe-1000 won, ngoko usengakwazi ukuzithenga.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Oku akuzange kongeze iingqekembe ezifunyenwe ngoku kwimali analo. Qala ujonge ukuba imali analo itshintshile na.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Isixa esisi-1005 sisingaphantsi kwemali analo, i-1020 won, ngoko unokuzithenga.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Oku kuthelekise ngokuthe ngqo imali analo etshintshileyo nesixa sokwenene. Kubonise kakuhle ukuba ulwazi olutsha lutshintsha imeko.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Uqikelelo lwe-1000 lungaphantsi kwe-1020, ngoko angazithenga ngokujonga uqikelelo kuphela.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Isigqibo siyafana, kodwa phinda ucinge ukuba uqikelelo nesixa sokwenene zazahluke njani. Ukuthelekisa uqikelelo nalo uqikelelo kunzima ukukuthemba xa umahluko umncinci.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: I-1005 ne-1020 ziyafana, ngoko asikwazi ukuthi leyiphi enkulu.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: I-1005 ne-1020 zinokuthelekiswa kwangoko. Thelekisa ubukhulu bamanani ukuze ubone ukuba lelipi elikhulu.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.reflect: Kwinkcazelo yokuba uqikelelo lokuqala lwaluyi-1000, yintoni owawunokuyazi nento owawungakwazi ukuyazi? Emva kokubona amanani achanekileyo kwiithegi zamaxabiso, nasemva kokufumana iingqekembe ezongezelelweyo, ukucinga kwakho okanye ukuqiniseka kwakho kwatshintsha njani? Ukuba ugcine ukucinga kwakho kokuqala njengoko kunjalo, yitsho nesizathu.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.prompt: Yenza ezimbini iinkomba zamaxabiso apho isixa soqikelelo siyi-1000 won kodwa isixa sokwenene asiyiyo i-1000 won. Inkomba enye mayibe nesixa esingaphezulu kwe-1000 won, kwaye enye ibe nesixa esingaphantsi kwe-1000 won. Isnekisi esiyi-a won nesiselo esiyi-b won zinye nganye linani lemvelo ukusuka kwi-100 won ukuya kwi-999 won.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokwenza inkomba enesixa esingaphezulu kwe-1000. Ixabiso elinye malibe ngaphezulu kancinane kwe-500 kwaye elinye libe ngaphantsi kancinane kwe-500.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ukuba sele wenze inkomba enye, tshintshanisa imali engaphezulu neyingaphantsi ukwenza inkomba enesixa esingaphantsi kwe-1000.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Onke amaxabiso omabini ngamanani emvelo ukusuka kwi-100 won ukuya kwi-999 won.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Onke amaxabiso omabini kufuneka abe ngamanani emvelo ukusuka kwi-100 ukuya kwi-999.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Ukuqikelela ngalinye kufutshane neyure kunye nokudibanisa kunika i-1000.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Ukuqikelela ixabiso ngalinye kufutshane neyikhulu kunye nokudibanisa akunikeli i-1000. Khangela umthetho wokuba uyenyusa xa idijithi yamashumi ingu-5 okanye ngaphezulu.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Ukuba isixa sokwenene siyi-1000 won ncam, sifana noqikelelo, ngoko asingomzekelo.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.explain: 487+518=1005 ingaphezulu kwe-1000, kwaye 480+510=990 ingaphantsi kwe-1000. Nokuba uqikelelo lufana, lulu-1000, izixa zokwenene zinokuba macala omabini omlinganiselo. Ngoko xa uqikelelo lulingana nomlinganiselo, ungagqibi ngoqikelelo kuphela; jonga ngocoselelo ngakumbi.
